_comment: In-game tips (owner, 2026-10-18). Each tip has a condition key the HUD checks (src/game/tips.ts); ANY always applies. Short, imperative, one idea each.

tips.text: PRESS P: THE PLANNER RANKS EVERY PLAN IT CAN BUILD. PLAN 1 IS USUALLY A GOOD START.
EARLY BEATS BIG: A SMALL PUSH YEARS AHEAD MOVES THE ROCK FURTHER THAN A BIG ONE LATE.
THE DASHED GHOST MARKS WHERE HOME WILL BE AT IMPACT: THAT IS WHERE THE ROCK IS AIMED.
PRESS ] TO SPEED UP. THE CLOCK SLOWS ITSELF WHEN THE LAST CRAFT ARRIVES.
BETA IS UNKNOWN UNTIL AFTER THE HIT: KEEP BUDGET FOR A SECOND MISSION.
BUDGET IS PILING UP. PRESS G: SURVEYS FIND THE NEXT ROCK EARLIER, AND LEAD TIME IS EVERYTHING.
PRESS T: RESEARCH BUYS FLYBYS, SAILS AND BIGGER IMPACTORS.
LESS THAN A YEAR LEFT: KINETIC NOW, OR PRESS E TO EVACUATE IF IT IS SMALL.
PREDICTED MISS. YOU CAN LET IT PLAY OUT, OR ADD A SAFETY MARGIN: BETA MAY DISAPPOINT.
PRESS ? ON ANYTHING TO READ WHAT IT MEANS. L OPENS THE LEARNING CENTER; ESC COMES BACK.
PRESS V FOR THE PLANET VIEW: THE FOCUSING RING IS THE TARGET YOU MUST STEER OUTSIDE.
F1 IS THE MANUAL. OPTIONS HAS COLOUR: MONO OR NEON.
